The evidence implies that the therapeutic effects of Donepezil may be indirectly influencing the pathophysiology of Alzheimer's disease without neurofibrillary tangles, possibly through mechanisms involving neurotransmitter modulation or neuroinflammation. However, the strength of this relationship is limited by the off-label nature of the use and the lack of direct clinical trials linking Donepezil to this specific form of Alzheimer's disease.
